architecture.description: Yami has its own home, panel, state, voice runtime, dashboard model and module registry. OpenClaw and Hermes are treated as upstream implementation sources, not as the public product identity.

coreModules.name: Voz Yami
coreModules.purpose: Wake word, talk mode, rest intent, single local voice and avatar speech state.

coreModules.name: Dashboard Yami
coreModules.purpose: Full-screen Tamagotchi home with scalable menu pages.

coreModules.name: Gateway Yami
coreModules.purpose: Local gateway status and user-triggered control.

coreModules.name: Chats Yami
coreModules.purpose: Conversation sessions per number and future communication modules.

coreModules.name: WhatsApp Yami
coreModules.purpose: Automatic text-first WhatsApp workflow with user-controlled blocks.

coreModules.name: Integracoes Yami
coreModules.purpose: Sistema universal de contas: Google, Microsoft, Apple, WhatsApp, Telegram, Discord, GitHub, GitLab, armazenamento, redes sociais, produtividade e futuras integracoes.

coreModules.name: Evolucao Yami
coreModules.purpose: Autoevolucao assistida por IA: transforma ideias em especificacoes, tarefas, prompts Codex e documentacao. Ciclo: analise, planejamento, implementacao, testes, validacao, integracao.

coreModules.name: Comunicacao Yami
coreModules.purpose: Native personal communication management — messaging, reading, assisted replies, conversation organization and contact reminders.

coreModules.name: Agenda Inteligente Yami
coreModules.purpose: Native smart calendar — appointments, reminders, routines, calendar sync and free time suggestions.

coreModules.name: Arquivos Yami
coreModules.purpose: Native file management — locate, organize, identify content, group, prepare for sharing and contextual search.

coreModules.name: Fotos Yami
coreModules.purpose: Native photo management — locate images, contextual search, albums, find by date/event and prepare for sharing.

coreModules.name: Compartilhamento Yami
coreModules.purpose: Native assisted sharing — share documents, images, audio and files with explicit user confirmation.

coreModules.name: Controle Yami
coreModules.purpose: Arquitetura de agente para controle total do sistema operacional. Orquestra acoes sobre apps, arquivos, processos, janelas, scripts, navegador e rede com planejamento contextual, permissoes, observacao e recuperacao de erros.

fileSharePolicyEnforced.name: Regra 2: Compartilhamento Explicito de Arquivos
fileSharePolicyEnforced.description: Nenhum arquivo deve ser enviado automaticamente. O YAMI so compartilha arquivos quando houver uma solicitacao explicita do usuario.
